ideas.title: Investigating the Trump Administration's Funding Freezes
ideas.description: This story would investigate the Trump administration's use of funding freezes as a means of exerting control over projects and states.
questions: What projects have been affected by the funding freezes?
How have the funding freezes impacted the affected states?
ideas.insight: I believe that this story has the potential to uncover a pattern of abuse of power by the Trump administration, and could lead to further investigations and accountability.
